name: Elizabeth Lewis
source: A seventh-year belonging to the House Dunagall. Elizabeth is the top student of her year, one of the prefects of House Dunagall, and one of the prettiest and nicest girls in the whole of Tír na nÓg. Dedication to her studies and her charming personality made her a favorite amongst both faculty and the students.
